speaker: AXIOM-7
text: AXIOM-7: Nexus Overseer core neutralized. All three quantum processing nodes have collapsed into terminal logic cascades. Mainframe defense grid has flatlined across the entire Citadel.

speaker: MIRAGE
text: MIRAGE: Look at the server towers—they're dumping petabytes of encrypted garbage! The automated reinforcement queues just zeroed out. The Citadel's robot army is dead in the water.

speaker: TITAN
text: TITAN: That Overseer thought its containment prisms could cage us. Turned its fancy laser ring into scrap metal. Look at the cooling lines—liquid helium is blowing every gasket in the room.

speaker: OCEANUS
text: OCEANUS: The thermal runaway is accelerating. The entire subterranean mainframe is melting down behind us. We can't linger here—the deck plating is already vibrating from reactor shockwaves.

speaker: SURYA
text: SURYA: The digital shield is broken, but look up through the gantry shaft. The Praetorian automated batteries have switched to emergency auxiliary generators. The Bastion above is locking down.

speaker: AURA
text: AURA: I hear them... heavy hydraulic footsteps. Praetorian battle mechs and elite cyber-samurai are rallying on the perimeter ramparts above. They know their brain is dead, and they're digging in for a final stand.

speaker: MIRAGE
text: MIRAGE: The Apex Ascent Lift is online! I've bypassed the executive security lockout. This high-speed freight lift will take us straight through the Bastion's throat!

speaker: AXIOM-7
text: AXIOM-7: Warning: Sensor telemetry detects extreme energy signatures atop the Spire. The Void Commander is aware of the Nexus collapse and has ordered the Bastion to fire at will.

speaker: KAITO
text: KAITO: Then we give them the fight they asked for. No more hiding behind machines and algorithms. Board the lift. Next stop: The Apex Bastion!
